II.}}</noinclude>and svvadled him in clothes, and laid him dovvne in a manger: because there vvas not place for them in the inne. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=8}}† And there vvere in the same countrie shepheards watching, and keeping the night vvatches ouer their flocke. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=9}}† And behold, an Angel of our Lord stood beside them, and the brightnes of God did shine round about them, and they feared vvith a great feare. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=10}}† And the angel said to them, Feare not: for behold I euangelize to you great ioy, that shal be to al the people: {{verse|chapter=2|verse=11}}† because this day is borne to you a {{sc|Saviovr}} vvhich is Christ our Lord, in the citie of Dauid. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=12}}† And this shal be a signe to you, You shal finde the infant swadled in clothes: and laid in a manger. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=13}}† And sodenly there vvas vvith the Angel a multitude of the heauenly armie, praising God, and saying, {{verse|chapter=2|verse=14}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ GLORIA IN EXCELSIS at Masse.}}∷ ''Glorie in the highest to God: and in earth peace to {{sup|‖}} men of good vvil''.⊣ {{verse|chapter=2|verse=15}}† b {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel at the second masse vpō Christmas day. And for a Votiue of our Lady from christmas to Candlemas.}}And it came to passe: after the Angels departed from them into heauen, the shepheards spake one to an other: Let vs goe ouer to Bethlehem, and let vs see this word that is done, vvhich our Lord hath shevved to vs. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=16}}† And they came vvith speede: and they found {{sc|Marie}} and Ioseph, and the infant laid in the manger. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=17}}† And seeing it, they vnderstood of the vvord that had been spoken to them concerning this childe. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=18}}† And al that heard, did maruel: and concerning those things that vvere reported to them by the shepheards. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=19}}† But {{sc|Marie}} {{sup|‖}} kept al these vvordes, conferring them in her hart. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=20}}† And the shepheards returned, glorifying and praysing God in al things that they had heard, and seen, as it vvas said to them.⊣ {{verse|chapter=2|verse=21}}† c {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Gen. 17, 12. Lu. 1, 31.''}}* And {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ The Gospel vpon the Circumcision of our Lord Ian. 1.}}∷ after eight daies vvere expired, that the childe should be circuncised: his name vvas called {{sc|Iesvs}}, vvhich vvas called by the Angel, before that he vvas conceiued in the vvombe.⊣ {{verse|chapter=2|verse=22}}† d {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Lev. 12, 6.''}}* And after the daies vvere fully ended of her purification {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ The Gospel vpon the Purification of our Lady or Candlemas day. · Leu. 12, 6.}}∷ according to the lavv of Moyses, they caried him into Hierusalem, to present him to our Lord {{verse|chapter=2|verse=23}}† (as it is vvritten in the lavv of our Lord, {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Exo. 13, 2.''}}* ''That euery male opening the matrice, shal be called holy to the Lord''.) {{verse|chapter=2|verse=24}}† and to giue a sacrifice {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Nu. 8, 16. Lev. 12, 8.''}}* according as it is written in the lavv of our Lord, a paire of turtles, or tvvo yong pigeons. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=25}}† And behold, there vvas a man in Hierusalem, named Simeon, and this man vvas iust and religious, expecting the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost vvas in him. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=26}}† And he had receiued an answer of the Holy Ghost, that he<noinclude>{{rh|||should}}</noinclude>
